_comment: Advisories the operator has decided to carry, for now (#1242). Every entry names the issue holding the decision and a review date; past that date the entry stops counting and the audit goes red again. A package fails unless EVERY advisory behind it is listed here.

entries.reason: braces 3.0.3: no patched version. Reached only through micromatch (admin-written policy globs), pm2 -> chokidar (operator watch config) and dev tooling; no user-supplied input. Hygiene, not a vulnerability.
sprintf-js 1.0.3: no in-range fix. Reached only through argparse 1.x, which only the js-yaml and mammoth CLI binaries load; the app uses the libraries, never the CLIs. Hygiene, not a vulnerability.
